personality_fit_block.callout: If you want work with a low barrier, fast earnings, and room to improve through skill, forklift operation can be a stepping stone. Keep advancing instead of stopping at driving alone.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Steady: operates without rushing
Precise: aligns stacks carefully
Safety awareness: constantly checks people and cargo
Hands-on ability: inspects and maintains equipment
Cooperation: works with inventory staff and loading docks

boundary_notice: 叉车工最大的风险是「自动化替代」——AI 和设备不是来帮忙的，是来替代重复劳动的，不转型就会在五年内看到岗位收缩。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合毛躁、粗心、恐高的人。叉车作业最忌讳求快，倒车看不见人就危险了；高位叉车要升到几米高取货，恐高的人干不了。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：考取叉车证（特种设备作业人员证）→ 入职仓储、物流、制造企业当叉车工 → 从平叉操作到掌握高位叉车/侧移叉车等特种车型 → 晋升班组长、仓库管理员，或转设备维护与调度岗位。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合动手能力强、心细、坐得住驾驶室的人。叉车操作讲究稳准，倒车入库、窄道转弯都要熟练；安全意识要强，忙起来也不能图快忘了看人看货。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你想要一份门槛低、来钱快、又能靠手艺精进的工作，叉车可以当跳板——但记得往上走，别停在纯驾驶。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 稳：操作不急不躁
细：码放对齐不马虎
安全意识：时刻看人看货
动手力：设备点检维护
配合度：和库管月台协作

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI, but only knowing how to tend a machine. Once machines perform every task they can, operators must take on what machines cannot do.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It is a poor fit for people who dislike heat and noise or want an easy job. Casting workshops are hot in summer and loud, and urgent production schedules can mean continuous shifts. This is demanding skilled work.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: study molds, mechanical engineering, or materials at a vocational school, become an operator apprentice at a foundry or injection molding plant, begin with loading and part removal, learn temperature and pressure adjustment and mold changes, then independently operate multiple machines and assist with mold setup.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits people with steady hands, sharp eyes, and the patience to understand machines. A five-degree difference in injection temperature or a few megapascals in die-casting pressure produces a very different part, so you must be willing to work through the parameters.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are willing to adjust parameters three times for one flash defect and tend an entire production line in a forty-degree workshop, this field offers skilled workers stable returns.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Strong hands-on ability: capable of changing molds, setting up machines, and maintaining equipment
Observation: anticipate problems from changes in part appearance
Patience: test parameters one by one without rushing
Responsibility: continuous production quality depends on constant monitoring
Safety and heat tolerance: able to handle hot, noisy environments

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会守机」——机器把自己能干的活都干了，操作员就得去干机器干不了的。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕高温、怕噪音、又想图清闲的人。铸造车间夏天热、机器声大，生产任务紧的时候连轴转，这行是典型的辛苦技术活。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：模具/机械/材料相关职校或专业 → 铸造厂或注塑厂操作学徒 → 从上下料、取件做起 → 学会调温调压、换模 → 独立操作多台设备并参与模具调试。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合手稳、眼准、又有耐心琢磨机器的人。注塑温度差五度、压铸压力差几个兆帕，出来的件就是两回事，你得肯跟参数较劲。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你愿意为一件飞边反复调三次参数，也愿意在四十度的车间里守一整条产线，这行会给手艺人稳定的回报。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 动手能力强：换模、调机、维护都拿得起
观察力：从件的外观变化预判问题
耐心：参数要一处处试，急不来
责任心：连续生产，质量全靠盯
安全与耐热：高温噪音环境能扛得住

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI, but surgical responsibility. No matter how perfectly AI plans an operation, the person standing beside the operating table remains accountable.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people who faint at blood, have unsteady hands, or cannot tolerate the pressure of the operating room. Emergency facial trauma can be graphic and moves at an uncontrollable pace; people unable to handle such scenes cannot do this work.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: undergraduate dentistry -> master's or doctoral study in oral and maxillofacial surgery with residency training -> obtain physician qualification and complete resident training -> specialize in dentoalveolar surgery, tumors, orthognathic surgery, or trauma -> advance to attending and associate chief physician.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits people with steady hands, close attention to detail, and the stamina for demanding surgery. A maxillofacial operation can require standing for three or four hours, staying calm when bleeding occurs, and patiently reassuring the patient afterward. A decisive manner in the operating room combined with attentiveness outside it is ideal.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are willing to exchange ten years of demanding study for a scalpel that can transform appearance, oral and maxillofacial surgery offers exceptional professional depth and stature.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Steady hands and attention to detail: appearance and function rest beneath the scalpel
Resilience: sustained pressure in surgery and emergency care
Decisiveness: rapid judgment when unexpected events occur
Empathy: understanding patients with deformities and trauma
Lifelong learning: technology evolves too quickly to stop

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「手术责任」——AI 帮你规划得再完美，最后担责的还是站在手术台边的人。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合晕血、手抖、受不了手术室高压的人。急诊面创伤一上来就是血肉模糊，节奏完全由不得你，承受不了这种场面的人干不了这一行。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：口腔医学本科 → 口腔颌面外科方向硕士/博士（规培）→ 取得医师资格并完成住院医师培训 → 专攻牙槽外科、肿瘤、正颌或创伤方向 → 晋升主治、副主任医师。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合手稳、心细、能扛手术强度的人。一台颌面手术可能站三四个小时，出血时要冷静判断，术后还要耐心安抚患者，这种「台上果断、台下细致」的复合性格最合适。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你愿意用十年苦学换一把「能改变面容的刀」，口腔颌面外科会给足你职业的高度与厚度。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 手稳心细：刀下是面容和功能
抗压：手术台与急诊的持续高压
决断力：意外情况下的快速判断
同理心：对畸形与创伤患者的理解
终身学习：技术迭代太快，停不下来

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI, but remaining in an old morphology-only model. Pathologists who use AI, understand molecular methods, and perform final review become more valuable as AI strengthens.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit impatient people, those who fear responsibility, or those unable to endure quiet work. Pathology rewards slow effort; difficult cases routinely take weeks, and a signed diagnosis carries lifelong responsibility.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: bachelor's degree in clinical or basic medicine → pathology or clinical pathology residency → physician licensure and pathology specialty credentials → frontline slide review → subspecialize in breast, hematopathology, neuropathology, or another field, or move into department management and research.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits people who can sit for long periods, notice details, and reason logically. It is a strong fit if you can spend half a day at a microscope without frustration, pursue literature and cases enthusiastically, and withstand the pressure of a single sentence changing a surgical plan.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you accept over ten years of training and heavy diagnostic responsibility in exchange for a deep professional moat, pathology is worthwhile.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Able to sit: spends half a day at the microscope
Rigorous: one word can change a diagnostic report
Logical: morphology leads to conclusions step by step
Accountable: signs reports and withstands responsibility
Investigative: pursues difficult cases to the end

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在形态学旧模式」——会 AI、懂分子、能终审的病理医师，AI 越强反而越值钱。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合急躁、怕担责、坐不住冷板凳的人。病理是慢功夫，一个疑难病例磨几周是常态，签字要背一辈子的责任。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：临床医学或基础医学本科 → 病理学或临床病理住院医师规培 → 取得执业医师资格与病理专科资质 → 从一线阅片做起 → 向亚专科（乳腺、血液、神经病理等）深耕或转向科室管理与科研。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合坐得住、心思细、逻辑强的人。你能在显微镜前坐半天不烦，读文献、追病例像追剧，还扛得住「一句话影响一台手术方向」的压力，这行很合适。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你能接受「十年磨一剑、诊断责任重，但职业护城河极深」的节奏，病理这行值得干。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 坐得住：显微镜前一坐半天
严谨：诊断报告差一个字都不同
逻辑强：从形态到结论，一环扣一环
担当：敢签字、扛得住责任
钻研：疑难病例愿意追到底

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but automation plus standardization. Objective grading is absorbed, while people with teaching ability become more secure.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This occupation does not suit people who dislike repetition, hate answering questions, or become impatient when an explanation is not understood. Teaching assistants often answer the same question ten times, making patience essential.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is to begin as a graduate student, work as a course assistant, independently lead discussions or laboratories, become a lecturer, and transition into teaching or research.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This occupation suits people who enjoy investigation, want to teach, and can focus for long periods. If genuine student understanding is your professional standard, you can thrive in this field.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy investigation, want to teach, and treat genuine student understanding as your professional standard, postsecondary teaching assistant work is one of the best entry points in academia for developing communication skills.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Investigative: understands content thoroughly
Patient: explains something ten times
Communication: explains clearly
Meticulous: grades accurately
Responsible: monitors student learning

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 标准化」——客观批改被吃，有教学力的人反而更稳。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕重复、讨厌答疑、讲不明白就急的人。助教常面对同样的问题问十遍，没耐心会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：研究生起步 → 做课程助教 → 独立带讨论/实验 → 做讲师 → 转教师或科研岗。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合爱钻研、愿意教、坐得住的人。你把「让学生真懂」当标准，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你爱钻研、愿意教、把「让学生真懂」当标准，高校助教是学术圈最练表达的入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 钻研：内容透
耐心：讲十遍
表达：讲得清
细致：改得准
负责：盯学情

boundary_notice: The greatest career risks are branch contraction + accountability for errors. Jobs are decreasing while tolerance for error falls.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who dislike monotony, repetition, or monitoring. Counter work involves many standardized actions, continuous audio and video recording, and accountability for errors. Restless or careless people will struggle.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common pathway is: finance or accounting education → campus or experienced bank recruitment → pre-employment training and job certification → begin at low or high counters → transition to relationship manager or operations supervisor.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits careful, steady people with strong numerical sense who can manage both systems and customers. If balanced accounts, reassured customers, and compliance are your standards, you can build a stable career here.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can remain seated, reconcile every number, and reassure people within strict rules, teller work is one of the most stable entry points into finance.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Extremely detail-oriented: Investigates every one-cent discrepancy
Compliance-minded: Never crosses a compliance boundary
Patient: Handles repetitive transactions and difficult customers
Numerically sensitive: Balanced accounts and clear records are fundamental
Steady: Maintains long focus under monitoring without errors

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「网点收缩 + 差错追责」——岗位在变少，容错在变低。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕枯燥、受不了重复和监控的人。柜面有大量标准化动作，还有全程录音录像和差错追责，坐不住或粗心的人会很难受。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：金融、会计相关专业 → 银行校园招聘或社会招聘入行 → 岗前培训与上岗证 → 从低柜、高柜做起 → 转理财经理或运营主管。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合细心、稳重、数字感好、能对着系统和客户两头应付的人。你愿意把「账平、客安、合规」当底线，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你坐得住、数得清、能在规矩里把人哄好，柜员是金融圈最稳的入口之一。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 极度细心：一分钱差错都要追到底
守规意识：合规红线一次不能碰
耐心：重复业务和刁钻客户都能接
数字敏感：账平表清是基本功
稳重：监控下长时间专注不出错
